Maria L: Hey infra — new Dedicated customer onboarding blocking on capacity in us-west2 :wave:. We need 8 x A100 v4 (single-tenant) + 40 additional internal IPs for the cluster. I opened a GCP case, details below. Can someone own escalation?
Samir: I can take a pass. Do you have the project ID and case number? Also, is this strictly A100 v4 or can we accept A100 v3 as a fallback? :eyes:
Maria L: Project: redwood-dedicated-prod, region: us-west2. Customer requires v4 due to perf profile (longer context, KV cache). Fallback would degrade latency; prefer to keep v4. Case: 122334455 — initial auto-reply received.
Ivan P: FYI I already opened a partner escalation as well, got Escalation ID E-39871 and partner ticket PT-88033. GCP replied with a templated note:
```
Support: We are validating physical availability in us-west2. Requested increase: "NVIDIA A100 v4" 8 GPUs and "INTERNAL_IPS" 40. Estimated ETA: 36-72 hours pending capacity checks.
Case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/122334455
```
GCP Support Bot: Case 122334455 updated by GCP: "Assigned to Regional Capacity Team" — status changed to "In progress".
Samir: Thanks. Can we also request a temporary cross-region fallback routing rule? If us-west2 can't fulfill, we should be able to place nodes in us-west1 and route traffic to them until capacity is met. Need to surface cost delta to product.
Maria L: Good idea. We should avoid hitting customer SLA. Ivan, can you add a note to the case asking for cross-region provisioning as a contingency? Add the exact CIDR ranges we'll need for peering.
Ivan P: Added note to case with peering ranges and routing suggestion. I also included the partner escalation reference. I pasted the gcloud command I used to open a quota request in case useful:
```bash
gcloud compute regions quotas update us-west2 --project=redwood-dedicated-prod \
  --update-quota=accelerator:v100:0,accelerator:nvidia-a100-v4:8,INTERNAL_IPS:40
```
(we used partner API as well, but CLI snippet for record).
Samir: I'll ping Finance/Billing on the cost side and ask for approval for cross-region fallback (estimate roughly +22% hourly on p4d/g4->a100 mapping until we get v4 capacity). I'll also escalate internally to our partner rep to push on the regional capacity team. :rocket:
Maria L: Thanks @Samir — assigning ownership to you for escalation and billing. I'll watch the support case and post updates here. Last cloud update said "Regional Capacity Team investigating, ETA ~36h". If nothing by EOD we'll request an exec-level review via our partner rep. :thumbsup:
GCP Support Bot: *Case 122334455 — note added by Ivan P.*
Maria L: Closing the loop for now — Samir, please post when you DM billing and when partner rep confirms priority. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for updates.
